name: AEPI
description: AEPI show rig (2026-10-31): Junior Crib (fan) with the two SHEHDS 180W heads swapped for two XFALIGHTS 90W RGBW mini beams sitting upright on the DJ stand, both 4 ft left of the stand's centre. Lasers, wash bar and laser_profile=fan unchanged from junior_crib_fan.json. Venue dimensions are Junior Crib's (NOT measured at AEPI) -- correct on the Venue tab.

slots.label: Moving Head L (90W)
slots.mount_note: Left 90W beam. Unit set to address 150 (MUST be in 15-channel mode). Josh 2026-10-31: both heads sitting upright on the DJ stand, 4 ft left of the stand centre (x = 8.5 ft); the +/-0.5 ft split between the two, y = 3.5 ft and z = 4.67 ft (stand top + head pivot) are ESTIMATES. Motion box is a conservative guess around straight-up (tilt 0.5 assumed vertical) -- recapture on the Venue tab.
